Cooperative; threads communicate to each other as to who will be scheduled next. Tasks give up control voluntarily
To the user, it will appear though as if each process has to complete, or require user input before the next process will execute
Premptive;  OS has the authority to interrupt threads and context switch
To user, it will look like time slicing, allowing for the appearance of multiple processes being computed simultaneously
